run_hanabi_game: run a Hanabi game with SearchBot using start_game and end_game from hanabi_lib
test_wait_for_my_turn: test the wait_for_my_turn function that blocks until the bot's turn using server and bot
start_hanabi_game: start a Hanabi game with a named bot and seed via start_game returning server, bot, and thread
end_hanabi_game: end a running Hanabi game by calling end_game with the server, bot, and thread objects
run_endgame_test: run the endgame test script that starts and ends two Hanabi games with SearchBot
